सयाकर-वत् mfn. (prob.) producing abundant crops, Kām.
स—यावक mfn. dyed with lac, Kir.
स—यावन् mf(अरी)n. going along with, associated with (instr.), accompanying, RV.
स—यौवन mfn. possessing youth, youthful, young, Ṛtus.
स—यूथ्य (स-), mfn. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 4, 114) belonging to the same herd or tribe, VS.; AitBr.

स—यज्ञ-पात्र mfn. together with sacrificial vessels, Hcat.
स—यक्ष्मन् mfn. having consumption, suffering from c˚, consumptive, MBh.
सयन n. binding, Nir.
सयन m. N. of a son of Viśvāmitra, MBh. (B. सेयन).
स—यन्त्र mfn. with or possessing machines, MW.
स—यन्त्र—जल-शैल mfn. having engines and water and a rock, ib.
स—यन्त्रिक mfn. together with a charioteer, KātyŚr.
स—यति mfn. having a caesura, with a caesura, Ked.
स—यत्न mfn. making efforts, taking pains with, endeavouring to (inf.; अम् ind. ‘with effort’), Hit.
स—यत्नम् ind., ‘with effort’
सय—त्व n. binding, fastening, TS.; TBr.; Kāṭh.
स—यव mfn. together with barley, Kauś.
स—य-व mfn. containing the sounds य or व, VPrāt.
स—योग mfn. possessed of Yoga, Ragh.
स—योग m. (mc.) for सं-योग, junction, union (opp. to वियोग), BhP.
स—योग n. (scil. गुण-स्थान, with Jainas) N. of the last but one of the 14 stages leading to emancipation, Cat.

m: स—योनि (स-), mfn. having a womb, female, L.
having the same womb, uterine, having a common origin with (instr.), RV.; AV.
connected with the womb or place of origin or birth-place &c., AV.; TS.
स—योनि m. (only L.) ‘one who is from the same womb’, a uterine brother
proximity to a wife (?) a pair of nippers for cutting areca-nut
N. or Indra
a: सयोनि — a. 1 Having the same womb, uterine. --2 Closely related to. --3 Closely united with the womb. --निः 1 A whole or uterine brother. --2 A pair of nippers for cutting betel-nut. --3 N. of Indra.

m: स—योनि—ता f. (AitBr.) identity of origin, the having the same birth-place.
स—योनि—त्व n. (TS.) identity of origin, the having the same birth-place.
स—योषण mfn. attended by women, along with the women, MW.
स—युधि-ष्ठिर mfn. with or accompanied by Yudhiṣṭhira, MW.
स—युग्वन् mfn. (fr. id.) united or associated with, a companion of (gen.), ib.
having a team of horses, ChUp.
स—युज् mfn. united, a companion, comrade, RV.; AV.; Br.; ŚrS.
स—युज् f. N. of partic. bricks, TS.
स—युज्य mfn. (fr. prec.) closely united with, MW.
स—युज्य—ता f. intimate union or junction, ib.
स—युक्त्व n. (fr. स-युज्) the being united, ŚBr.
